description: This file defines the DashboardProvider class, which manages the state of the dashboard in a Flutter application. It fetches transaction data for the current month from a repository and computes a summary for display purposes, notifying listeners when data updates occur.

classes.name: DashboardProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that handles loading and updating dashboard summary data based on transactions fetched from the repository for the current month.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches transaction data for the current month and updates the dashboard summary, then notifies listeners.
